candidate.title: What is Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) ? Simplified Explanation
candidate.description:
Learn what Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is and how it combines retrieval and generation to create accurate, context-driven responses. This simple explanation covers why RAG is needed, how it works, and its real-world applications. Perfect for anyone curious about the latest advancements in AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
